triggers.evidenceNote: The bars show each trigger group's share of the absolute LightGBM contributions (log-odds) to E168's forecast change in household food insecurity. narrative: FOOD-INSECURITY RISK for CALABARZON, 2027-Q1 (E168 forecast): 0 of 5 provinces HIGH; highest forecast share Quezon 36% of households moderately or severely food insecure (HIGH at 50%); Lead-1 forecast: meets the acceptance rule (accuracy 0.750 on 72 past provincial forecasts; latest survey alone 0.625). These are model attributions, not causes.
note: The risk score shown is the estimated food-insecurity risk index (FIRI v2), a proxy composite on a 0-1 scale in which 0.5 means every indicator is at its historical middle. Each bar is a factor group's exact share of how far the index moved from 0.5: red groups are above their usual level and raise the estimate, green groups are below it and lower it. Market / Prices = the LightGBM food-price-pressure forecast, headline inflation and rice prices; Climate Stress = PAGASA El Nino status, typhoons, palay and corn production; Fish Kill = fisheries production (not fish-kill events); Employment and OFW Remittance = national figures. Household vulnerability, regional hunger (SWS, Balance Luzon) and news are also in the index but not among the five bars; their share and every domain score and weight are in the summary text. Shares describe how the estimate is built from the evidence; they are not causes.

summary.sentence: FOOD-INSECURITY RISK for CALABARZON, 2027-Q1 (E168 forecast): 0 of 5 provinces HIGH; highest forecast share Quezon 36% of households moderately or severely food insecure (HIGH at 50%); Lead-1 forecast: meets the acceptance rule (accuracy 0.750 on 72 past provincial forecasts; latest survey alone 0.625).
summary.caveat: A forecast risk class, not a measured food-insecurity rate. It was validated on 72 provincial forecasts from 3 survey rounds (2018, 2019, 2021): accuracy 75.0% at one quarter ahead against 62.5% for the latest survey alone. It tends to over-predict by about 3 points (about 2 in 5 HIGH calls were false alarms) and rarely misses a HIGH province.

modelIdentity.modelVersion: E168 (e168-lgbm-1.0): latest provincial HFIAS survey level + constrained LightGBM change (five trigger groups, news inside groups) + calibration. Leads 1-3 meet the acceptance rule (Lead 1 accuracy 0.750 on 72 provincial forecasts; latest survey alone 0.625).
modelIdentity.lead2Accuracy: Lead 2: accuracy 0.778 on 72 provincial forecasts (latest survey alone 0.625), HIGH precision 0.63, recall 0.88, F1 0.73, AUC 0.89.
